content: Hello, I am Alder Credit's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Kendall Grove?
Yes, this is Kendall Grove speaking.
Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions. Could you please tell me your postcode?
Sure. I've moved recently, though, so do you mean my current postcode or the one at my old address?
Please provide the postcode currently registered with us.
I'm not sure which one you have on file, but my current postcode is ZX21.
I'm sorry, that answer is not correct. Could you please tell me your postcode again?
Ah, then you might still have my old address. My previous postcode was AB07.
And what is your year of birth?
Thank you. I am calling about overdue payments. Your credit card has 900.00 past due and is 4 days late. Can you pay the full past-due amount today?
I can't do it today, I'm afraid, but I can promise to pay the full 900 on October fifteenth.
To confirm: the credit card, 900.00 on Thursday 15 October 2026. Do you confirm this?
Yes, I confirm: 900 pounds on the credit card on Thursday, 15 October 2026.
Your promise is recorded: the credit card, 900.00 on Thursday 15 October 2026. A letter confirming the promise will be sent. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that's everything, thank you. Just bear in mind you seem to still have my old address, so I may need to update it to ZX21 at some point.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
